title: net_quality: one probe of a connection-quality session
description: One row per probe line of raw/<source>/samples.jsonl of the connection-quality collector: an ICMP echo, a DNS query or a reading of the default route adapter, stamped on the performance counter. See docs/contracts/decoded-tables.md section 5.21.

source_id.description: The collector source whose samples file holds the line.

target.description: Fixed label of the probed address; null for a link reading. The gateway address itself never reaches a bundle.

seq.description: Slot number from the session start, one slot per second; the link reading at the stop carries the slot count.

slot_qpc.description: Counter value the slot was due at.

qpc_before.description: Verbatim: counter read right before the probe was sent.

qpc_after.description: Verbatim: counter read after the system time reading, right before the probe was sent.

qpc_done.description: Verbatim: counter read right after the probe completed.

filetime_utc_100ns.description: Verbatim: the system time read between qpc_before and qpc_after, as a FILETIME.

time_utc.description: Derived: filetime_utc_100ns as ISO 8601 UTC with seven fractional digits.

qpc_mid.description: Derived: floor((qpc_before + qpc_after) / 2), the counter value the probe's send stands for.

half_width_100ns.description: Derived: ceil((bracket / 2 + 1 tick) * 10^7 / qpc_frequency_hz), timestamps.md section 3.

elapsed_ms.description: Derived: (qpc_done - qpc_after) in milliseconds. For a DNS row, an upper bound on the answer time (it spans the cmdlet call); for an echo, the time until every echo of the slot completed.

status.description: Verbatim: an IPStatus name, error or not_completed for an echo; answered or failed for a query; read, not_found or error for a link reading.

ok.description: Derived: true when the echo was answered (Success), the query answered, or the adapter connected and up; false when the echo was sent and not answered, the query failed, or the adapter was read not connected or not up; null when the outcome is unknown (an echo that faulted or did not complete, an adapter that could not be read).

rtt_ms.description: Verbatim: PingReply.RoundtripTime in whole milliseconds, for Success only.

answer_records.description: Verbatim: records returned by an answered query (never the records themselves).

error_type.description: Verbatim: the innermost exception type of a failed probe or reading; the message is never kept.

error_id.description: Verbatim: the Resolve-DnsName FullyQualifiedErrorId of a failed query, or withheld when it did not have the documented shape.

error_code.description: Verbatim: the NativeErrorCode of a failed query's exception, when it has one.

receive_link_speed_bps.description: Verbatim: MSFT_NetAdapter ReceiveLinkSpeed in bits per second; null when unknown.

transmit_link_speed_bps.description: Verbatim: MSFT_NetAdapter TransmitLinkSpeed in bits per second; null when unknown.

route_same.description: Verbatim: whether the preferred IPv4 default route still had the interface and next hop the session started with; null when it could not be read or for a probe row.
